_comment: Rime crystals round a spyglass, the lens that looks into the Age, with a copper bulb under it to light
them, on a stand of iron bars set with prismarine crystals (Jonah, 2026-10-01). Rime because a crystal
is the thing a viewer is made of rather than a stand-in for a lens (design 7.4). The prismarine is the
Overworld mastery an early implement asks for alongside (design 7.4, Jonah, 2026-11-11): only a guardian,
so only an ocean monument, gives it. Ratios are unbalanced.
